dataset: World 3 Bahasa Inggris Wajib Chapter 1 - Misi 11 (Expressions & Conditionals)
purpose: Bank soal fondasi (Layer 1) untuk penguasaan Grammar & Expressions Dasar (World 3).

questions.question:
Receptionist: 'Good morning, Sir. May I help you with your baggage?'
Guest: 'Yes, please. I have two heavy suitcases in the trunk.'
The receptionist's utterance expresses...
questions.explanation: The phrase 'May I help you' is a standard formal expression used to offer assistance or a service to someone else.
questions.provenance: Soal orisinal pemahaman konteks dialog pelayanan (K13).
questions.subject: Bahasa Inggris

questions.question:
'If you want to pass the final exam with flying colors, you ________ study harder starting today.'
Choose the most appropriate modal to complete the conditional sentence with an advice.
questions.explanation: This is a Conditional Sentence type 1 pattern used to give advice (If + simple present, subject + should/ought to/had better + V1). 'Should' is the most appropriate modal for giving strong advice.
questions.provenance: Soal orisinal drill grammar K13 untuk menguji struktur 'If Clause + Suggestion'.
questions.subject: Bahasa Inggris

questions.question:
Read the dialogue.
Sarah: 'I failed my driving test again.'
Mark: 'If you hadn't been so nervous about the parallel parking, you wouldn't have hit the cone.'
What can we infer from Mark's statement?
options: Sarah is not nervous anymore about driving.
Sarah hit the cone because she was nervous.
Mark thinks parallel parking is the hardest part.
Sarah passed the test despite hitting the cone.
questions.answer: Sarah hit the cone because she was nervous.
questions.explanation: Mark uses a Type 3 Conditional ('If you hadn't been... you wouldn't have...'), which describes a past unreal situation. The reality is the opposite of the 'if' clause: she WAS nervous, and as a result, she DID hit the cone.
questions.provenance: Soal orisinal literasi bahasa TKA yang menguji penarikan kesimpulan (inference) dari struktur tata bahasa tingkat lanjut (Conditional Type 3).
questions.subject: Bahasa Inggris
